run_asr_pipeline_native_whisper: run the AsrPipeline with InlineAsrNativeWhisperOptions to transcribe audio files using OpenAI Whisper
run_asr_pipeline_mlx_whisper: run the AsrPipeline with InlineAsrMlxWhisperOptions to transcribe audio files using MLX Whisper on Apple Silicon
build_conversation_items: build _ConversationItem objects with start_time, end_time, speaker, and text for ASR transcript segments
build_conversation_words: build _ConversationWord objects with start_time, end_time, and text for word-level ASR timestamps
process_conversation: process a list of _ConversationItem objects and add them as text entries with timestamps to a DoclingDocument
